- 来源：[X 原帖](https://x.com/Naonekozamurai/status/2094340753195725179)
- 摘要：A black athlete silhouette crosses blue water, a pink cycling ramp, and a three-way finish in a fast triathlon motion graphic. Native-video output: 15s · 2560×1440. The creator published the complete prompt, preserved here verbatim.

```text
MiniMax H3を使用して、15秒・2Kのスタイリッシュなモーショングラフィック＆キネティック・タイポグラフィーによるトライアスロン動画を制作する。

映像は、水泳4秒、自転車4秒、ラン4秒の順に展開し、最後の3秒は画面を斜めに3分割して、3つの競技を同時に見せる。スローモーションは使用せず、15秒間を通してスピード感と力強いテンポを維持する。

主人公は、全身が黒一色で描かれた一人の人間のシルエット。顔、髪、肌、競技ウェアなどの細部は描かず、プロのトライアスロン選手を思わせる、引き締まったしなやかな体型として表現する。

水泳、自転車、ランのすべてで、同じ体格、身長、身体の比率を持つ同一人物の黒いシルエットを維持する。背景には競技ごとに異なる明るく鮮やかな色を使用し、黒い人物との強いコントラストを保つ。

【0.0～4.0秒：SWIM】

映像は、鮮やかなシアンとブルーで構成された、抽象的でスタイリッシュな水面から始まる。カメラは水面すれすれの斜め前方から主人公を捉え、黒いシルエットが水を切りながら高速で泳いでくる。

主人公は正確で力強いフリースタイルを行う。左右の腕を交互に大きく前へ伸ばし、水中を後方へ押し出しながら、脚は自然で連続的なフラッターキックを行う。腕の入水、キャッチ、プル、リカバリーを滑らかにつなげ、途中で一度だけ横を向いて自然に呼吸する。

単に水面の上で腕を回しているようには見せず、身体の大部分を水中に維持し、前方へ進む推進力、水の抵抗、浮力、飛沫に物理的な説得力を持たせる。

腕が水面へ入るたびに円形の波紋が広がり、水を後方へ押すとシアンの太いラインと細かな光の粒子が進行方向と反対側へ流れる。キックに合わせて、水中に細いグリッドや波状のシェイプが現れる。

カメラを水面すれすれの追従ショットから、斜め上の俯瞰ショットへ切り替える。俯瞰ショットでは、主人公の全身、水面を切り裂く軌道、左右へ広がる波紋を明確に見せる。

背景には「SWIM」という単語を正確なスペルの大文字で登場させる。「SWIM」は水中から浮かび上がるように現れ、音楽のビートに合わせて拡大、縮小、前後方向への移動、軽い3D回転を行う。

3D回転した「SWIM」は必ず再び正面を向き、単語全体が明確に読める瞬間を作る。文字は主人公の背後や水中へ配置し、泳ぎを妨げないようにする。

4.0秒の強いビートで、主人公の腕が作った大きな円形波紋を画面いっぱいに拡大する。その円形波紋を、次のシーンの自転車の前輪へグラフィック・マッチさせ、シャープに切り替える。

【4.0～8.0秒：BIKE】

拡大した水面の円形波紋が、黒い競技用ロードバイクの前輪へ瞬時に切り替わる。背景の色は、ブルーとシアンから、鮮やかなマゼンタ、コーラル、オレンジへ大胆に変化する。

主人公は黒一色の競技用ロードバイクに乗り、抽象的で近未来的なロードコースを高速で走行する。上半身を低く保った空気抵抗の少ない姿勢でハンドルを握り、両脚でペダルを滑らかに高速回転させる。

ロードバイクは、細いフレーム、ドロップハンドル、サドル、クランク、ペダル、チェーン、同じ大きさの2つの車輪を持つ、正しい競技用自転車の形状として描く。

カメラは真横から高速で並走し、主人公の全身と自転車全体を捉える。続いて、地面すれすれから前輪とペダリングを大きく見せるローアングル、斜め上からコースの曲線を見せる俯瞰ショットへ、音楽のビートに合わせて大胆に切り替える。

車輪が回転すると、マゼンタとオレンジの円形ラインが短い軌跡として残る。ペダルを踏み込むたびに背景のシェイプが後方へ加速し、コースを曲がると長方形、三角形、太いライン、グリッドが同じ方向へ大きく傾く。

背景には「BIKE」という単語を正確なスペルの大文字で登場させる。「BIKE」は道路面から立ち上がるように現れ、車輪の回転と連動して3D回転、拡大、縮小、奥行き方向への移動を行う。

3D回転した「BIKE」は必ず再び正面を向き、単語全体が明確に読める瞬間を作る。文字は主人公や自転車と接触する物体ではなく、背景のグラフィック要素として使用する。

8.0秒の強いビートで、主人公がペダルを力強く踏み下ろす。ペダルを踏み込む足元のアップから、ランで足が地面へ接触する瞬間へ、動きの方向とリズムを維持したマッチカットで切り替える。

【8.0～12.0秒：RUN】

背景は、鮮やかなイエロー、ライムグリーン、バイオレットを組み合わせた、抽象的でスタイリッシュなランニングコースへ切り替わる。

主人公はトライアスロン終盤のランを思わせる、力強く持続的なペースで走る。単なる短距離スプリントではなく、上半身を安定させ、肘を自然に曲げ、腕を前後へ効率的に振りながら、高いピッチで前方へ進む。

接地した足の真上へ身体の重心が自然に移動し、反対側の膝が前方へ上がる。足の接地、蹴り出し、空中局面、次の接地を滑らかにつなげ、左右の脚を正しく交互に動かす。

カメラは真横から主人公と同じ速度で追従し、全身のランニングフォームを見せる。続いて、斜め前方から迫ってくる主人公を捉えるショット、足元すれすれのローアングル、斜め上からコースを見下ろす俯瞰ショットへ切り替える。

足が地面へ接触するたびに円形の波紋が広がり、蹴り出すと鋭いラインが後方へ走る。腕の振りや走行リズムに合わせて、長方形、円、三角形、グリッドが画面の上下左右からスライドインし、次のビートでスライドアウトする。

背景には「RUN」という単語を正確なスペルの大文字で登場させる。「RUN」は主人公の後方から急速に追いつくように画面奥から移動し、ビートに合わせて拡大、縮小、3D回転、軽い伸縮、色の切り替えを行う。

3D回転した「RUN」は必ず再び正面を向き、単語全体が明確に読める瞬間を作る。文字で主人公の身体や足元を覆い隠さない。

12.0秒の強いビートで主人公が力強く地面を踏み込む。接地点から3本の太い斜めラインが広がり、そのラインによって画面全体を3つのパネルへ分割する。

【12.0～15.0秒：3競技同時表示】

画面を、少し傾いたシャープな境界線によって、左、中央、右の3つの縦長パネルへ分割する。

左側のパネルでは、シアンとブルーの水中を、同じ黒い主人公がフリースタイルで泳ぎ続ける。背景には「SWIM」を表示する。

中央のパネルでは、マゼンタ、コーラル、オレンジのロードコースを、同じ黒い主人公がロードバイクで高速走行する。背景には「BIKE」を表示する。

右側のパネルでは、イエロー、ライムグリーン、バイオレットのコースを、同じ黒い主人公が力強く走り続ける。背景には「RUN」を表示する。

3つのパネルは静止画にせず、水泳のストローク、自転車のペダリング、ランの足運びを同時に継続させる。それぞれの動きを同じ音楽のビートへ同期させ、3競技が一体となったトライアスロンのリズムを作る。

分割画面では、それぞれのパネルに主人公を1人だけ表示する。同じ競技の人物を同じパネル内で複製しない。各パネルの人物、用具、背景が、隣のパネルへはみ出したり、混ざったりしないようにする。

終盤に向けて、各パネルの波紋、車輪の円形ライン、ランの接地エフェクトを徐々に高密度にする。最後の強いビートで3つの動きが同時にアクセントを作り、パネルの境界線と背景のシェイプが整列する。

最後の約0.6秒は、「SWIM」「BIKE」「RUN」の3語と、3競技を行う主人公の姿が明確に確認できる安定した3分割画面として保持し、クールに終了する。大げさな決めポーズや喜ぶ動作は入れない。

【モーショングラフィックと音楽】

水泳では、水の飛沫、波紋、波状のラインを、音楽の細かいビートへ同期させる。自転車では、ペダリング、車輪の回転、コースの通過を、ベースと連続するパーカッションへ同期させる。ランでは、左右の足の接地を、キックとスネアへ正確に同期させる。

水泳から自転車、自転車からランへ進むにつれて、音楽、カメラ、シェイプ、タイポグラフィーの動きを徐々に高密度にし、最後の3分割画面で3つのリズムを統合する。

背景のシェイプは人物や競技用具を完全に隠さず、それぞれの動作が常に明確に見えるようにする。制御されたモーションブラーを使用するが、人物の手足や自転車の車輪が複数に見えるほど強くしない。

【文字と一貫性】

映像内に登場する文字は「SWIM」「BIKE」「RUN」の3種類だけに限定する。すべて正確なスペルの大文字で表示し、文字の欠落、重複、誤字、別の文字への変化を起こさない。それ以外の文字、数字、企業名、ロゴ、ウォーターマーク、字幕は表示しない。

通常の競技シーンでは、主人公を一人だけにする。最後の3分割画面に限り、同じ主人公を各パネルへ一人ずつ表示する。

水泳シーンでは、自転車やランニングコースを登場させない。自転車シーンでは、水中表現や余分な自転車を登場させない。ランシーンでは、自転車やフープなどの競技用具を登場させない。

競技用ロードバイクは必ず1台だけにする。車輪を2つに限定し、フレーム、ハンドル、サドル、クランク、チェーン、ペダルの形状と位置を維持する。車輪の複製、変形、消失、瞬間移動を発生させない。

自転車走行中は両手を正しくハンドルへ置き、両足をペダルへ固定する。ペダルと脚を正しく連動させ、足がペダルから外れたり、フレームや車輪を貫通したりしない。

主人公の形状、体格、頭、胴体、手足の本数を15秒間一貫させる。手足の変形、身体の分裂、不自然な残像、競技間での性別や体格の変化を発生させない。

大胆でありながら統一感のある配色、シャープなグラフィック、強い遠近感、正確なビートシンクを組み合わせ、とにかくカッコよく、スタイリッシュで、スピード感とファッション性の高い映像に仕上げる。SNSで拡散されそうな、センスが良く、中毒性があり、何度も見返したくなる高品質なトライアスロン動画にする。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic realism, epic fantasy war climax, hyper-real and tragic. The same red-haired female warrior from <Picture 1> is fully preserved in face, hair, body proportions, dual swords, armor, burning battlefield, skulls, spears, smoke, embers, sparks, and infernal war atmosphere. IMAX 70mm film grain, inspired by Nolan cinematic aesthetics, photorealistic natural color grading with charcoal black, umber, dark ochre, ash gray, and pale amber interwoven. The whole video is one continuous shot with no cuts. The camera stays low and close, retreating under pressure while also making slight side drift, subtle breathing-like push-pull, one short impact disturbance, a curved move around her front-side during the breakdown, and a low dipping follow into the fall. From 00:00.000 to 00:04.500, she charges straight toward the lens at high speed, chest angled slightly toward camera-left, head forward, eyes locked ahead, mouth slightly open, breathing hard, shoulders and core tight. One sword drives low at frame-right, the other opens wider at frame-left. Hair, straps, armor, cloth, and blades all carry strong secondary motion. Embers cross the lens and flames boil behind her. From 00:04.500 to 00:06.200, a heavy arrow blasts in from the off-screen right-front side and hits high in her right upper torso near the shoulder and chest. The impact is like a hammer: right shoulder jerks back, chest contracts, head and neck snap slightly rearward, and her breath is cut off. The camera gives one short force reaction. From 00:06.200 to 00:10.500, she does not fall immediately. She forces half a step to one and a half more steps forward while losing control: upper body tipping backward, lower body still trying to drive ahead, compensation steps failing, pain and disbelief visible in her face. The camera arcs around her front-side to watch the breakdown. One sword slips free first and is thrown or dropped; the second weapon also loses control and falls out of its attack line. Hair, shoulders, arms, armor, leather, and weapons all lag with visible inertia while sparks and fire whip around her. From 00:10.500 to 00:13.200, the collapse fully breaks through in layers: upper body whips farther back, chest and shoulder are dragged open by the wound, legs try one last catch and fail, knees buckle, and she slams backward or diagonally backward with heavy force. The camera follows the fall with a low dipping angled movement. From 00:13.200 to 00:15.000, her body and weapons hit the ground with one deep heavy impact, throwing up dust, embers, sparks, and debris. The camera stays low with a small drifting or sinking continuation, holding her as a fallen legend rather than a weak victim. Fire and battlefield ash keep moving to the end.

overall_soundscape: Heavy running footfalls, armor and weapon movement, wind, ember crackle, distant fire roar, arrow whistle, brutal impact into armor and body, broken breath, stumbling loss of control, weapon drops, and one deep final body-and-metal crash.

entries.title: Multiplication Tables with Fish Pairs
entries.author: タナベ | AI動画 × マーケティング
entries.summary: An orange cat guides a nine-pool grid where paired fish and beat-matched equations teach the two-times table. Native-video output: 15s · 2560×1440. The creator published the complete prompt, preserved here verbatim.
entries.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Adorable rounded 3D animation for preschool children, soft studio lighting, subtle contact shadows, smooth gradients, and a calm uncluttered vertical composition on a clean off-white background with a very soft pale-blue glow behind the center. Use a restrained palette of off-white, warm orange, cream, turquoise blue, and dark gray: orange is the cat, turquoise is the fish and every correct answer, dark gray is the equation. The camera is a Static Shot for the entire film. A small smiling cat mascot bounces gently into the upper area: a big rounded head on a short chubby body, warm orange fur, a cream muzzle, cream belly and cream paw tips, two small rounded triangle ears with pale pink inner lining, round full cheeks, simple black dot eyes, tiny whiskers, and a thick rounded tail. It lands with a soft squash-and-stretch, its tail curls up once behind it, and it taps the air with one front paw, creating a spreading circular pale-blue water ripple. The ripple opens outward and reveals a three-by-three grid of nine small empty pale-blue water pools in the lower half of the frame, with a clear empty space for one large equation above them. A warm young Japanese female narrator with a bright, soft voice (S1) chants in a steady rhythmic sing-song counting cadence, one line per beat, and begins: <d>[Japanese] にのだん!</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:01.200, one large thick rounded dark-gray equation appears in the upper space and is rewritten twice in place, holding each state clearly on its own beat: first "2 × 1 = 2", then "2 × 2 = 4", then "2 × 3 = 6". On each new equation, exactly one matching pair of two plump turquoise-blue fish drops together into the next empty water pool with a small splash. The two fish of a pair are identical, side by side, both facing right and slightly offset so both are clearly countable, each with a cream belly, a triangular tail, and one round black eye. The pairs fill the top row from left to right, and the answer numeral turns turquoise as each pair lands. At the end of this shot exactly three pools in the top row are filled, each holding exactly two fish, for six fish in total; six pools remain empty. (S1) chants on the beat: <d>[Japanese] にいちがに。ににんがし。にさんがろく。</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:04.700, a soft pale-blue water ripple wipes across the frame and the same large equation continues to be rewritten in place on each beat: "2 × 4 = 8", then "2 × 5 = 10", then "2 × 6 = 12". One matching pair of two fish drops into the next empty pool on each new equation, filling the middle row from left to right, and the answer numeral turns turquoise as each pair lands. Two-digit answers stay large, correctly formed, and fully readable. The three pairs already in the top row stay exactly where they are and do not move, change, or multiply. At the end of this shot exactly six pools are filled, each holding exactly two fish, for twelve fish in total; three pools remain empty. (S1) chants on the beat: <d>[Japanese] にしがはち。にごじゅう。にろくじゅうに。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:08.100, a soft pale-blue water ripple wipes across the frame and the large equation is rewritten in place on each beat for the last time: "2 × 7 = 14", then "2 × 8 = 16", then "2 × 9 = 18". One matching pair of two fish drops into the next empty pool on each new equation, filling the bottom row from left to right, and the answer numeral turns turquoise as each pair lands. The six pairs already placed stay exactly where they are and do not move, change, or multiply. At the end of this shot all nine pools are filled, each holding exactly two fish, for eighteen fish in total. (S1) chants on the beat: <d>[Japanese] にしちじゅうし。にはちじゅうろく。にくじゅうはち。</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:12.100, the final equation "2 × 9 = 18" stays in the upper space and its turquoise answer numeral "18" gently enlarges once and settles. Below it, the nine pairs of fish gain small friendly smiles and their tails flick once, in a quick wave from the top-left pool to the bottom-right pool, each pair flicking together as one. The same warm-orange cat mascot from [Shot 1], unchanged in every detail, bounces in at the lower edge beside the grid and points up toward it with one front paw while its tail curls once and small pale-blue sparkles rise around it. Exactly nine pools remain, each still holding exactly two fish, and no new objects enter. (S1) says: <d>[Japanese] よく できました!</d> Hold the complete grid, the equation, and the cat clearly and without further motion until the film ends exactly at 00:15.000.

Throughout the entire film, keep the camera a Static Shot, keep the off-white background clean and empty, keep the single equation large, thick, rounded, correctly shaped, and centered in the upper space, and keep the fish design identical in every shot. Every filled pool always holds exactly two fish - never one, never three - and the two fish of a pair always arrive together, land together, and stay together as one unit. The cat must look exactly the same in [Shot 1] and [Shot 5], identical in fur color, head and body shape, ears, eyes, and tail, and it never appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], or [Shot 4]. Only one cat is ever on screen, it stays beside or above the grid, and it never stands on, reaches into, covers, or eats any fish. Only one equation is ever visible at a time. Display only numerals and the symbols × and =. Do not generate any hiragana, katakana, kanji, Latin words, or any other written characters anywhere on screen. Fish only ever accumulate, never disappear, never leave their pool once placed, and never overlap; the number of filled pools must exactly match the multiplier of the current equation, and the total fish count must exactly match the answer numeral, reaching exactly eighteen fish in nine pools at the end. Avoid fast camera movement, sudden cuts, cluttered backgrounds, tiny typography, warped or duplicated numerals, reversed two-digit numbers, wrong counts, extra or missing fish, unpaired single fish, fish appearing before their equation, fish swimming freely around the frame, realistic or scaly fish anatomy, scary expressions, harsh colors, heavy motion blur, and loud or distracting sound effects.

overall_soundscape: A soft double water plop sounds each time a pair of fish drops into a pool. A light padded paw tap sounds when the cat touches the air, and one single soft kitten meow occurs as the cat first bounces into frame. Gentle spreading water ripples mark the two transitions, and a small confirmation chime sounds each time an answer numeral turns turquoise. Tiny shimmer sparkles occur around the cat at the end.

non_diegetic_music: A light nursery jingle at a steady moderate tempo using marimba, soft celesta, and gently plucked strings, with a clear repeating beat that the chant lands on. Begin with a single marimba figure, add one instrument at each row of the grid, and thin back out for the final line. Resolve with a clean rising three-note chime landing at 15.000 seconds.

entries.title: Orange-and-Black Street Dance Commercial
entries.author: タナベ | AI動画 × マーケティング
entries.summary: A street dancer performs through rapid orange-and-black geometric layouts before a giant Japanese title closes the spot. Native-video output: 15s · 2560×1440. The creator published the complete prompt, preserved here verbatim.
entries.prompt:
----------------------
integrated_multimodal_description:
2D-animated, a bold graphic-design motion-graphics commercial in 16:9 with exactly 13
distinct cuts at 24fps. This film is 85% kinetic graphic design and 15% character action:
giant kinetic Japanese typography, hard-edged flat shapes, split screens, halftone, speed
lines, torn-paper reveals and shutter flashes. Palette, strictly four colors: fluorescent
orange, deep black, off-white, silver grey. The recurring character is a young anime street
dancer with a black chin-length bob and blunt bangs, sharp confident eyes, an oversized
off-white track jacket with fluorescent-orange sleeve stripes, black cargo shorts, and
chunky white sneakers with fluorescent-orange lines. Preserve her exact face, proportions,
hairstyle, outfit, materials and colors throughout; never redesign her. Every graphic
element moves fast and snaps hard on the beat.

[Shot 1] On a deep black field, a massive off-white circle slams into frame left of center,
then two fluorescent-orange bars wipe across the upper and lower thirds, then the Japanese
kanji "烈" builds itself stroke by stroke in off-white at the center until it is complete.
The camera shakes slightly with small amplitude at fast speed on each impact.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, the camera cuts to an off-white field where four black squares
rotate into the center one at a time. The largest square opens as a porthole revealing an
extreme close-up of the dancer's ice-sharp eye glancing up, then a red-and-cyan split flash
tears across the edges and the squares shatter into flat shards. The camera pushes in with
small amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to an off-white field filled by an enormous black
kanji "烈". The dancer sprints in from frame left, power-slides along the baseline of the
typography, and fluorescent-orange ink splatter trails behind her as speed lines streak
past. The camera trucks left with large amplitude at fast speed. The kanji stays fully
readable before she crosses in front of it.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.100, the camera cuts to a vertical triptych of fluorescent-orange, deep
black and off-white panels. Her flat silhouette appears in each panel in stroboscopic
freeze, one after another — takeoff, mid-air tuck, landing — while giant vertical silver
text "全速" scrolls upward behind the panels. Static shot.

[Shot 5] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a black field where a giant tilted ring of
fluorescent-orange Japanese characters reading "止マルナ" rotates. The dancer leaps through
the center of the ring, spins once in mid-air, and the characters break off and scatter
outward as flat shards. The camera arcs with large amplitude at fast speed, then snap-zooms
onto her confident face.

[Shot 6] At 00:05.100, the camera cuts to a clean off-white editorial card holding a huge
black kanji "跳" with one orange diagonal slash. She vaults over the word itself, plants her
palm on its left radical, the character compresses like a spring under her hand, then
rebounds as her legs whip across the frame. Static shot.

[Shot 7] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a full fluorescent-orange field crossed by one
thick black diagonal stripe. She back-flips along the stripe in three stroboscopic ghost
frames tinted black, off-white and silver grey, while a large outlined kanji "回" rotates
180 degrees in sync with her rotation. The camera rolls clockwise with small amplitude at
fast speed.

[Shot 8] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to an off-white field with a hard black band. Four
bold black kanji slam in one at a time at different scales and angles — "速", then "鋭",
then "静", then "烈" — each landing with a white shutter flash and an orange impact mark,
while she slides on her knees across the foreground, jacket flaring. The camera shakes
slightly with small amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 9] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a black frame where a white wireframe grid tilts
away in 3D. She runs up the grid like a wall, kicks off it, and hangs frozen in mid-air as
a fluorescent-orange circle stamps around her pose like a target lock with silver UI
brackets and tick marks. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed.

[Shot 10] At 00:09.000, the freeze releases and the camera cuts to layered flat-color panes
stacked toward the lens. She dives straight at the camera, the panes tear open one at a
time like thick paper, and each tear reveals a larger portion of the black kanji "烈"
behind, before her sneaker wipes across the foreground. The camera pulls out with large
amplitude at fast speed.

[Shot 11] At 00:10.100, the camera cuts to a rapid-fire montage of four full-screen graphic
posters of her in different action poses — mid-flip, sliding, landing, hands in pockets —
snapping past with hard cuts, each with an oversized silver number 01 to 04, a black
barcode strip and thick diagonal slashes. Static shot.

[Shot 12] At 00:11.100, the camera cuts to a clean off-white cyclorama for the hero moment.
She lands a final backflip dead center in slow motion, straightens with both hands in her
pockets, and a shockwave of concentric fluorescent-orange rings blasts outward from her feet
carrying shattered fragments of the kanji "烈" with it, then the frame overexposes toward
white. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

[Shot 13] At 00:13.000, the camera cuts to the final identity card on a pale off-white
field. An enormous black kanji "烈" dominates the frame with translucent orange rings and
thin technical arcs behind it, the silver-grey word "RETSU" sits directly beneath the kanji,
and she stands relaxed at the lower center overlapping the bottom of the strokes with her
jacket rippling. One thin orange pulse sweeps horizontally through the typography and holds
cleanly until exactly 15.000 seconds. Static shot.

Editing: extremely aggressive rhythm — hard cuts on every beat, graphic matches, whip pans,
snap zooms, stroboscopic freezes, foreground wipes, split flashes and impact shakes. Every
cut must feel compositionally different. All Japanese typography is always fully readable
before the character overlaps it. No weapons, no combat, no fire, no explosions; all energy
comes from motion design, ink, torn paper, wind and her street-dance athleticism. No
photorealism, no 3D rendering, no gradients, no browser interface, no player controls, no
subtitles, no captions, and no text other than the Japanese characters named above.
Exactly 13 cuts.

overall_soundscape:
Sneaker impacts, knee slides and landings hit hard against a clean room tone. Ink splatters
burst, thick paper tears open, and flat panels shatter like glass. Sharp whooshes carry the
color wipes and typography slams, with small shutter clicks on each flash. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
An original 15-second drum-heavy breakbeat with a deep sub bass, hard snare hits, risers and
glitch fills locked to every cut. Begin with a single impact, build tightly through the
middle, peak at the landing at 00:11.100, and end with a cold electronic logo sting that
resolves at 15.000 seconds.

entries.prompt: A handheld found-footage shot from behind a person playing an authentic Street Fighter II arcade cabinet in a dim 1990s arcade. Ryu and Ken begin a normal match as the announcer shouts, “Fight!” The camera suddenly rushes toward the curved CRT screen in one continuous motion; reflections and scanlines expand into giant glowing red, green, and blue phosphor dots, then the camera passes through them and the image resolves into a clean full-screen 4:3 Street Fighter II game view with crisp 16-bit pixel art and subtle CRT scanlines. Chun-Li unexpectedly jumps into the match, followed by Blanka dropping from above, Dhalsim teleporting into the center, Zangief charging in, and several more fighters entering from both sides. The stage widens as the match becomes a chaotic but readable eight-player free-for-all: Sonic Booms cross the screen, Blanka’s electricity shocks multiple fighters, Zangief spins through a crowd, characters collide in midair, and health bars rapidly drain. Everyone unleashes a special move at once, filling the screen with pixel explosions and impact flashes. When the smoke clears, every fighter is knocked out except Dhalsim, calmly floating above the pile. The announcer declares, “Dhalsim wins. Perfect!” Authentic arcade sound effects, energetic chiptune music, no modern 3D graphics, no camera shake after entering the game.

entries.prompt:
[REFERENCE CONTROL]

Use the uploaded PART 2 storyboard image as the PRIMARY visual, character, prop, environment, camera, lighting, and narrative reference for the entire video.

Use the storyboard to preserve:
- exact Part 2 story progression
- Lena Cruz and Jax Mercer identity continuity from Part 1
- Rico Vale’s appearance and attitude
- the dark muscle car
- black SUV convoy
- black drive
- unfinished overpass environment
- sunset-to-night lighting progression
- graphic-novel cinematic style
- chase escalation
- standoff
- Jax’s “disabled drive” reveal
- Lena and Jax recovering the drive
- final victorious walk-away

Do NOT reproduce the storyboard sheet itself.

The finished video must contain:
- no panel borders
- no storyboard numbers
- no timestamps
- no captions
- no production notes
- no paper background
- no reference-sheet layout

Convert the entire board into one coherent finished cinematic animated sequence.

[VIDEO GOAL]

Duration: exactly 15 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape
Video style: premium cinematic 2D graphic-novel animation
Genre: Hollywood-style action thriller / road chase
Tone: fast, stylish, tense, controlled, cinematic, triumphant

Narrative progression:

high-speed pursuit
→ convoy closes in
→ Jax breaks formation
→ unfinished overpass
→ convoy collapses
→ Rico standoff
→ disabled-drive twist
→ brief safe disarm
→ drive recovered
→ cool final exit

This is PART 2 only.

Begin immediately with the chase already underway.

Do NOT repeat the gas-station setup from Part 1.

End exactly after Lena and Jax recover the black drive and walk toward their muscle car while Jax delivers the final line:

“Enough to burn his empire.”

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCKS]

LENA CRUZ

Young athletic woman.

Appearance:
- warm medium skin
- sharp expressive eyes
- high dark ponytail
- red patterned bandana over lower face or around neck
- fitted dark cropped top
- light denim shorts
- practical dark footwear
- lean athletic proportions
- confident silhouette

Personality:
bold, reactive, fearless, intuitive, aggressive under pressure but controlled.

Beginning emotion:
focused pursuit intensity.

Ending emotion:
quiet satisfaction and confidence.

Movement:
fast head turns,
athletic body control,
decisive reactions,
strong braced posture during the car chase,
quick efficient movements during confrontation.

Keep identical in every shot:
- face
- skin tone
- ponytail
- bandana
- clothing
- height
- body proportions
- age
- eye shape

JAX MERCER

Tall athletic young man.

Appearance:
- short dark hair
- intense eyes
- dark blue patterned bandana covering lower face or around neck
- dark fitted T-shirt
- brown / charcoal pants
- strong controlled physique

Personality:
calm strategist,
precise,
rarely panics,
tactical,
protective.

Beginning emotion:
extreme concentration.

Ending emotion:
controlled victory.

Movement:
efficient driving,
minimal wasted motion,
calm body language even during danger.

Keep identical:
- face
- hairstyle
- blue bandana
- shirt
- pants
- height
- proportions
- body build

RICO VALE

Original crime boss character.

Appearance:
- stylish dark hair
- confident narrow eyes
- clean or lightly stubbled face
- dark tailored street jacket
- dark shirt
- restrained jewelry
- smug posture
- sophisticated silhouette

Personality:
arrogant,
calculated,
confident,
believes he has already won.

Beginning emotion:
smug control.

Ending emotion:
surprised and outplayed, but physically unharmed.

Do not make Rico grotesque, psychotic, or horror-like.

[PROP LOCKS]

BLACK DRIVE:
small matte-black rectangular data device.
Same exact shape and size throughout.
It must remain visually readable in Rico’s hand and later Lena’s hand.

JAX’S DEVICE:
small generic dark handheld screen / phone.
During the twist, it displays a simple red warning-style state indicating the drive is disabled.
Avoid recognizable real-world phone branding.

RICO’S PISTOL:
stylized generic dark handgun.
Only used as a visual standoff prop.
No firing.
No bullets.
No injuries.
It is safely knocked away during the confrontation.

MUSCLE CAR:
same dark charcoal muscle car from Part 1.
Wide stance.
Long red rear light treatment.
Strong low silhouette.
No real-world logos.

BLACK SUVs:
large matching dark SUVs.
Consistent shape and scale.
No branding.

[ENVIRONMENT LOCK]

The chase moves through:

1. desert-edge highway
2. narrowing service road / construction route
3. unfinished elevated overpass

Preserve coherent geography.

OVERPASS:
- concrete barriers
- construction barricades
- exposed structural elements
- orange safety lamps
- distant city lights
- dusty road
- dramatic open skyline

Lighting progresses naturally:

bright orange-magenta sunset
→ deeper red-purple dusk
→ cool blue night shadows with warm residual horizon light

[WORLD / ACTION PHYSICS]

All vehicle and character motion should feel grounded and cinematic.

Vehicles must show:
- weight
- suspension movement
- tire grip
- braking momentum
- body roll
- road vibration
- realistic acceleration

No weightless vehicles.
No flying cars.
No impossible spins unless physically motivated.

Action follows:
anticipation → attack → consequence → reaction.

The confrontation is brief and stylized.
No graphic violence.
No prolonged fight choreography.

integrated_multimodal_description:

[SHOT 1] (0.00s–2.10s) — FULL-SPEED PURSUIT

Open immediately on Jax’s dark muscle car accelerating hard down a sunset highway.

Two black SUVs close from behind and another runs ahead.

Tires throw road grit.
Warm sunset reflections streak across the car body.

Cut inside.

Jax grips the wheel firmly, eyes locked forward.

Lena braces in the passenger seat, twists around, and tracks the lead SUV through the side and rear windows.

Camera:
Start with a low rear three-quarter tracking shot beside the muscle car.
Sweep into an aggressive side tracking angle.
Cut to a tight interior two-shot.

Camera speed:
fast but readable.

Emotion:
focused urgency.

Dialogue:

Lena (sharp):
<d>[English] Lead truck. Eleven o’clock.</d>

Jax (calm):
<d>[English] Got it.</d>

Lena:
<d>[English] Don’t lose him.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] Wasn’t planning to.</d>

Sound:
- deep muscle-car engine
- SUV engines behind
- tire noise
- road rumble
- rushing wind
- seat and clothing movement
- low rhythmic action pulse

Transition:
One SUV moves alongside and begins closing the gap.

[SHOT 2] (2.10s–4.10s) — THE BOX-IN

Two black SUVs attempt to compress Jax’s car between lanes.

Lena leans toward the passenger window and keeps her eyes fixed on the lead SUV.

Her ponytail and red bandana react naturally to airflow.

Jax sees a narrow service lane opening ahead.

He makes one decisive steering move and sends the muscle car through the gap before the SUVs can close it.

The car drops onto the service lane with a heavy suspension compression.

One pursuing SUV follows too aggressively.

Camera:
High rear chase angle showing the box-in formation.
Cut to Lena’s profile tracking the target.
Then low front-quarter shot as Jax cuts across into the service lane.

Emotion:
pressure → opportunity.

Dialogue:

Lena:
<d>[English] They’re boxing us in.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] Not anymore.</d>

Sound:
- engines climbing
- tire scrub
- brief horn
- gravel spray
- suspension thump
- quick percussion hit as Jax breaks formation

Transition:
The pursuing SUV enters the service road too fast.

[SHOT 3] (4.10s–6.00s) — CONVOY BREAKS

The pursuing SUV clips a lightweight construction barrier.

The barrier spins aside.

The SUV loses alignment and skids safely into additional barricades, sending sparks and dust sideways.

No people are visibly injured.

Jax’s muscle car continues forward.

Ahead, the road rises onto an unfinished elevated overpass.

The lead SUV carrying Rico accelerates toward it.

Camera:
Dynamic low roadside angle as SUV loses control.
Brief wide shot of the impact.
Then long-lens chase composition revealing the overpass ahead.

Emotion:
momentary advantage but increasing danger.

Dialogue:

Lena:
<d>[English] One down.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] Don’t celebrate yet.</d>

Sound:
- tire squeal
- construction barrel impacts
- metal scrape
- restrained sparks
- engine acceleration
- wind intensifying

Music:
add stronger percussion and low synth pulse.

Transition:
Jax’s car climbs the overpass ramp behind Rico.

[SHOT 4] (6.00s–8.00s) — THE ROAD ENDS

Wide cinematic shot of the unfinished overpass suspended above distant city lights.

Only the lead SUV and Jax’s muscle car remain in the immediate chase.

Rico’s SUV swerves past construction barricades.

A final sharp turn forces the SUV to skid sideways near the unfinished end of the overpass.

Dust rises.

Jax brakes hard and stops several car lengths away.

The muscle car settles on its suspension.

The engines idle.

Suddenly the chase becomes quiet.

Camera:
Aerial-like wide establishing shot over the overpass.
Fast tracking behind both vehicles.
Then controlled side shot of Rico’s SUV skidding.
Slow push toward the two stopped cars.

Emotion:
speed collapses into tense silence.

Dialogue:

Lena (quiet):
<d>[English] End of the road.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] For somebody.</d>

Sound:
- hard braking
- tire squeal
- gravel sliding
- engine rumble falling to idle
- distant wind
- action music suddenly strips back to a low pulse

Transition:
Rico’s driver door opens.

[SHOT 5] (8.00s–10.10s) — RICO SHOWS HIS HAND

Rico steps from the SUV.

He casually holds the matte-black drive up between two fingers.

In his other hand is a generic stylized handgun held low and controlled.

Lena and Jax exit their muscle car and stand several meters away.

No one rushes.

Rico smiles.

Camera:
Low hero-villain angle on Rico stepping out.
Cut to over-the-shoulder from behind Lena and Jax.
Push into the black drive.
Then medium three-shot.

Emotion:
Rico feels victorious.
Lena looks ready to move.
Jax remains unusually calm.

Dialogue:

Rico (smug):
<d>[English] You two really came all this way for this?</d>

Lena:
<d>[English] Hand it over.</d>

Rico (small laugh):
<d>[English] You were never supposed to leave that station.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] And yet, here we are.</d>

Sound:
- wind across unfinished concrete
- distant city ambience
- SUV cooling ticks
- fabric movement
- quiet ominous bass tone

Transition:
Rico raises the drive slightly as if showing off his victory.

[SHOT 6] (10.10s–12.10s) — JAX’S TWIST

Jax slowly takes out his small dark handheld device.

The display shows a simple red disabled-state warning.

He tilts it toward Rico.

Rico looks from the device to the black drive.

His smug expression disappears.

Lena’s eyes narrow with a small knowing smile.

Camera:
Close-up of Jax’s calm eyes.
Insert on generic device screen.
Reaction close-up on Rico.
Cut to Lena.

Dialogue:

Rico:
<d>[English] What did you do?</d>

Jax (calm):
<d>[English] The drive was dead before you left the station.</d>

Rico:
<d>[English] You’re bluffing.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] Try it.</d>

Sound:
- subtle electronic confirmation tone
- wind
- low bass pulse
- tiny musical reversal sting

Important:
The technology is fictional and should not depict real hacking procedures or operational instructions.

Transition:
Rico instinctively looks down at the drive.

That moment creates the opening.

[SHOT 7] (12.10s–13.60s) — THE OPENING

Lena suddenly flicks / tosses a harmless small loose object or handful of construction dust across Rico’s line of sight.

Rico reacts instinctively.

Jax immediately closes the distance.

In one short stylized motion, he redirects Rico’s weapon arm away and the pistol is knocked loose.

The pistol slides safely across the pavement away from everyone.

Lena moves past Rico and takes the black drive.

Rico ends safely on one knee or sitting against a construction barrier, surprised but visibly unharmed.

Do not show detailed combat technique.
Keep the movement fast, cinematic, and impressionistic.

Camera:
Quick lateral whip-follow toward Lena’s distraction.
Low medium shot on Jax’s intervention.
Macro insert of pistol sliding away.
Close shot on Lena securing the drive.

Emotion:
precise teamwork.

Dialogue:

Lena:
<d>[English] Now.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] Done.</d>

Rico (frustrated):
<d>[English] You think this changes anything?</d>

Sound:
- quick object flick
- cloth movement
- short safe physical impact
- pistol clatter and slide
- drive grab
- restrained cinematic hit

No gunshot.

Transition:
Red-blue light reflections appear far behind them.

[SHOT 8] (13.60s–15.00s) — RECOVERY / HERO EXIT

Lena stands holding the recovered black drive.

Jax joins her.

Rico remains safely behind them, disarmed.

Far down the overpass approach, faint police lights flash in the distance.

Lena and Jax calmly walk toward their waiting muscle car.

The last orange strip of sunset sits beneath a deep violet-blue sky.

Lena looks down at the drive, then toward Jax.

Camera:
Begin medium on Lena holding the drive.
Slow lateral move as Jax joins her.
Then transition into a wide rear hero shot as they walk toward the muscle car.

Final composition:
Lena and Jax walking side by side.
Muscle car ahead.
Red taillights glowing.
City beyond.
Police lights distant.
Rico left behind safely.
Black drive visible in Lena’s hand.

Dialogue:

Lena:

Use the uploaded Part 1 storyboard image as the PRIMARY visual and narrative reference for the entire video.

- Part 1 cliffhanger ending

Do NOT reproduce the storyboard sheet itself in the finished video.
No panel borders, timestamps, handwritten captions, production notes, reference-sheet layout, paper texture, storyboard numbering, or storyboard text should appear in the video.

Transform the storyboard into one continuous polished cinematic animated action sequence.

[VIDEO GOAL]

Duration: exactly 15 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape
Style: premium cinematic 2D graphic-novel animation
Genre: action thriller / crime chase
Tone: stylish, tense, fast, mysterious, controlled
Story structure:
quiet pickup → suspicious exchange → betrayal reveal → convoy trap → rapid escape → real drive spotted → chase begins

This is PART 1 only.

Do NOT continue into the highway chase or overpass confrontation.
The exact final story beat is Lena realizing:
“They still have it.”

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK]

LENA CRUZ:
Young athletic woman with a high dark ponytail, sharp expressive eyes, red patterned bandana covering or resting around her lower face, fitted dark cropped top, light denim shorts, practical shoes, lean athletic proportions.

bold, observant, quick-reacting, fearless, direct.

- denim shorts

- age
- eye shape
- silhouette

[SHOT 1] (0.00s–2.20s) — THE PICKUP

Start with a wide cinematic exterior of the isolated roadside gas station under a dramatic orange-magenta sunset.

Long shadows cross slightly wet asphalt.
The convenience-store interior glows with cool fluorescent light.
The station canopy is illuminated against the colorful dusk sky.

Lena and Jax walk toward the station together from the foreground.

As they approach the pumps, they stop.

Jax slowly scans the perimeter, checking parked vehicles, road entrances, and reflections in the store windows.

Lena adjusts the red bandana over her lower face and looks toward the convenience-store door.

She gives Jax a tiny confirming glance.

Jax gives a subtle nod.

Lena separates from him and walks toward the store.

Camera:
Begin with a low wide-angle establishing dolly toward them.
Transition into a medium two-shot.
Subtle arc around Lena as she turns toward the entrance.

quiet professionalism with underlying suspicion.

Follow Lena through the glass entrance.

[SHOT 4] (6.20s–8.40s) — THE TRAP CLOSES

Exterior from Jax’s perspective.

Multiple black SUVs turn into the gas station from different entrances.

Headlights flare directly toward him.

One SUV swings across the driveway.
Another rolls near the pumps.
A third blocks the road exit.

Jax instantly understands.

His relaxed posture snaps into tactical alertness.

He turns toward the convenience store.

Fast controlled push-in as headlights appear.
Brief low-angle shot of tires turning into the station.
Return to Jax.

[SHOT 5] (8.40s–10.80s) — BREAK THE TRAP

She grabs the edge of a lightweight product display and shoves it sideways, creating visual cover between herself and the front windows.

Packaged goods scatter across the floor.

No one is struck.

At the same time outside, Jax moves along the side of the building toward a rear service exit.

He shoulders or kicks the jammed rear door near the latch.

The door bursts outward.

Use a rapid intercut rhythm between Lena and Jax.

Lena sprints toward the rear.

Jax reaches through and pulls the door wide for her.

Dynamic medium tracking with Lena.
Low angle as display moves.
Cut to Jax moving beside brick wall.
Close shot on his boot/body impacting the jammed door.
Wide rear-exit reveal.

rapid controlled survival response.

Lena:

- packaged items falling
- shoe impacts
- rear-door metal thud
- alarm begins chirping
- SUV doors outside
- tense rhythmic percussion increasing

No gunfire is necessary.

Lena and Jax sprint together behind the station.

Industrial rear lot:
chain-link fence,
service barrels,
wet asphalt,
dumpsters,
utility pipes,
warm sunset beyond the rooftops.

Lena heads toward passenger side.

Camera:

Brief rear tracking shot toward the car.
Natural speed blur at frame edges while keeping faces and silhouettes readable.

Dialogue:

<d>[English] Tell me you brought the car.</d>

Jax:
<d>[English] You’re looking at it.</d>

Lena:
<d>[English] Good answer.</d>

Sound:

- breathing
- clothing movement
- alarm chirp
- distant SUV engines
- keys / car unlock click

[SHOT 7] (12.80s–15.00s) — THE REAL DRIVE / CLIFFHANGER

Lena glances backward.

Across the rear service lot, one of Rico’s crew is stepping into the lead black SUV.

In his hand:

Lena’s eyes lock onto it.

Jax is already in the driver seat and starts the muscle car.

Lena dives into the passenger side.

The engine roars.

The lead SUV accelerates away.

Jax launches after it.

The muscle car swings out from behind the station and begins pursuit as other black SUVs move behind them.

red taillights glowing,

- door slam
- tire chirp
- accelerating muscle-car engine

entries.prompt:
Create a 15 second cinematic sports video in 16:9 inside a real indoor strength competition arena packed with spectators. The story contrasts repeated failure with one calm, unexpected success. It must feel like authentic live event footage captured by a professional broadcast crew, with natural human motion, believable weight, consistent anatomy, coherent crowd behavior, and physically accurate object movement.

0.00 to 2.70 seconds. Show three rapid failed keg toss attempts by three different heavyweight athletes. Use low sideline wide shots that include the athlete, tall steel throwing rig, red crossbar, and full keg arc. Each attempt lasts less than one second. One keg clips the bar and spins backward, one falls short, and one drifts sideways. The athletes show brief frustration while the crowd gives disappointed gasps. Use clean match cuts based on the circular keg shape.

2.70 to 4.40 seconds. Let the music soften. Cut to a medium wide shot of an unassuming compact middle aged competitor entering from the arena tunnel. He wears a plain black competition shirt, dark blue shorts, knee sleeves, lifting shoes, and a worn leather belt. He walks calmly toward the keg while larger athletes watch from the edge of frame.

4.40 to 7.20 seconds. Use three tactile close shots. Chalk pressing into his palms. Fingers locking around a cold dented steel rim. Shoes gripping the gray rubber floor as his knees bend. Show subtle breathing, sweat, fabric tension, skin compression, and a slight forearm tremor. Keep the same face, body, wardrobe, keg, and arena geography in every shot.

7.20 to 11.80 seconds. Continue in one unbroken low angle tracking shot with a natural 35 mm lens look. He swings the keg between his legs, drives through the hips, extends the knees, pulls upward, and releases at the correct moment. The camera makes a controlled upward tilt. The keg rotates with realistic inertia and follows a clean parabolic arc. Use natural motion blur at 30 frames per second with a 1 over 60 shutter feel. Hold a brief near silence before release.

11.80 to 13.40 seconds. The keg clears the red crossbar by only a few centimeters and lands heavily on the padded platform behind the rig without an unrealistic bounce. The crowd erupts on impact. A judge instinctively raises both arms to confirm success.

13.40 to 15.00 seconds. Cut to a medium close shot as the competitor raises one fist and gives a restrained relieved smile. Larger athletes behind him stare in disbelief, then applaud. Finish on a natural crowd reaction, not a freeze frame.

Use cool white overhead arena lighting, subtle blue haze, realistic warm skin tones, gentle lens bloom around practical lights, deep readable shadows, neutral cinematic color, controlled contrast, fine film grain, realistic sweat highlights, and no excessive sharpness.

Sound and music. Use an original 82 BPM cinematic percussion track with deep toms, restrained bass pulses, and a steady tension build. Layer authentic arena room tone, crowd murmur, chalk rubbing, metal scraping, shoe friction, breathing, a sharp air movement sound during release, a solid steel landing impact, and a powerful crowd swell after clearance. No dialogue.

Do not include text, captions, logos, watermarks, brand names, duplicated spectators, warped faces, extra fingers, changing clothing, inconsistent body size, floating objects, rubbery metal, impossible physics, sudden camera teleportation, or artificial slow motion. The final result must look photographic, grounded, spontaneous, and genuinely filmed at a live competition.
